messages:
Leah: Heads-up: we're getting a spike of fncall validation rejects on the payment_intent tool after last night's client patch. Small volume but sharp rate increase, mostly us-east. :thinking_face:
Omar: any code changes on our side? adapters?
Leah: adapters unchanged. Logs show amount_cents is coming back as a string. Example from recent trace (redacted):
```json
{"tool":"payment_intent","result":{"status":"success","amount_cents":"1000","currency":"USD"}}
```
Leah: our strict validator for fncall expects amount_cents: integer so these are hard rejects in the canary.
Priya: this counts against strict-validate quotas and pollutes the validation chart. Sampling is low (0.1%) so it's hard to debug.
Nik: ping payment owners? @payments-bot can you confirm recent API surface changes?
payments-bot: Payment API: rolled client formatting change 2024-04-03T22:12Z. Server-side unchanged.
Omar: ok so client introduced numeric-string, which bubbled through the adapter. We need a short fix path. Options: rollback strict canary, patch adapter to coerce numeric-strings->int, or relax schema.
Leah: rollback loses telemetry for any real regressions. Coercion seems fastest but we must not hide genuine schema drift.
Priya: suggest: coerce only when the value matches ^\d+$, add a telemetry tag 'coerced_amount_cents', and bump route-level payload sampling to 5% for 1 hour. That gives visibility without global sampling.
Nik: agree. Also console needs to show 'coerced' vs 'reject' filters. Right now all validation events are lumped together. Ops needs to filter by tag.
Omar: I'll open a small PR: adapter coercion + telemetry tag + route flag to override sampling. ETA ~1h. Will include an example event schema change in the PR message.
Priya: I'll file a console request to add a temporary panel for 'coerced fncalls' and a quick query: validation_events where tag='coerced_amount_cents' OR reason='type_mismatch' grouped by final_model_variant. We need final_route/model in the validation event to avoid misattribution from multi-variant routing.
Leah: good call. Currently telemetry attributes to the incoming route id, which is confusing when degen variants or fallback paths are involved. We should attach final_route and model_variant in validation events.
Nik: small UX note for rollouts: annotate the rollout page that strict validation can spike during multi-variant routing and that attribution may lag until final model is known. Make that visible to the on-call.
Omar: follow-up: telemetry pipeline change to append final_route and model_variant to validation records. That will require a short migration for dashboard queries. I'll add it to the PR.
Leah: immediate plan summary: 1) Omar: PR for coercion + tag + sampling override (ETA 1h). 2) Priya: console filter/panel request and query (ETA today). 3) Nik: rollout UX blurb and annotation (ETA today). 4) Leah: monitor rejects and consider rolling back canary if noise does not drop in 30m.
Priya: runbook blurb: if validation spikes: check recent adapter/client releases, increase route sampling, look for telemetry tag 'coerced_*', decide coerce vs rollback, and ensure attribution uses final model_variant.
Omar: note: implement coercion narrowly (numeric-string only). Don't coerce '1,000' or currency formats with decimals; surface those as rejects. We'll log an event when coercion occurs.
Nik: agreed. Also avoid increasing global sampling; use route-level override to limit storage.
Leah: ping me after the PR lands and after 30m of monitoring. I'll post metrics back here. :wave:
